Keep the old background softness and local light strength, not a sharper newly uniform U-shaped physical object. Preserve the existing quiet red reticle pigment, every old weak red edge and native phase. No white/neon glints, extra target circle, new radial rays, letter, font, scratch, metallic rim or embellished background. Gently resolve only existing soft painted continuity. Supporting guide pixels are source samples, not hard mosaic/stair decoration. Full historical canvas orientation/UV/scale/margins; no crop, padding, registration, recentering or rotation. Actual source alpha is a 20x20 opaque rectangle at x3..22,y3..22 with A0 outside; opaque black RGB inside is intentional. Full original A will be restored independently, but this does not repair inner RGB geometry or black gaps. Keep those in generated RGB. Exactly ONE old red circular reticle band centered at native (13,12), FOUR old cardinal inward short bright ticks and ONE separate tiny bright central dot. Outer band phase/extents follow source around x5..21 and y4..20; do not standardize its irregular red width or extend it. Bright source samples R>=230,G/B<40: top tick x13,y4..6, lower x13,y18..20; horizontal y12 at x5..7 and19..21; center dot exactly (13,12). Preserve each tick, one dot, native asymmetry and dark gap between center dot and circle. Whole source 676 RGBA cells authoritative, weak pigment remains weak and vague.
